economy.summary: One of eleven sponsors of a July 2026 House Republican legislative package aimed at lowering consumer electricity costs, including eliminating the Gross Receipts Tax on electric utility service, and expanding energy generation in Pennsylvania.
economy.short: Sponsors package to lower electricity costs, expand energy generation.

taxes.summary: In response to the governor's 2023 budget address, said he supports reducing the Corporate Net Income Tax and creating a more inviting climate for existing businesses, and said that using one-time Rainy Day Fund money for recurring costs is not a recipe for success.
taxes.short: Supports corporate tax reduction; opposes one-time funds for recurring costs.

healthcare.summary: Prime sponsor of a 2026 resolution directing the Legislative Budget and Finance Committee to study the cost to the Commonwealth of defraying health insurance benefit mandates under the Affordable Care Act; the resolution requests a study rather than stating a broader healthcare platform.
healthcare.short: Proposes study of state health insurance benefit mandate costs.

energy.summary: Co-authored a legislative memo proposing to eliminate Pennsylvania's Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI) regulation and to prevent similar proposals from proceeding without legislative approval, saying RGGI threatens energy jobs and could increase electric bills.
energy.short: Proposes eliminating RGGI, citing energy jobs and electric bills.

guns.summary: Listed as a previous co-sponsor of legislation to exclude firearms and ammunition purchases from Pennsylvania's sales and use tax; this is a tax measure related to firearms, and no broader gun-policy statement from him was found.
guns.short: Co-sponsored excluding firearms, ammunition from state sales tax.
